cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. We're on the allotment waiting list. You used to throw seedlings out before I'd even shown you how to thin them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can start tomatoes on my windowsill. One thing at a time; you always wanted the whole garden before the first leaf.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take my sunny room. I'll move the bed. You can show me you remember the spacing while I find somewhere else to sleep.
